other_conditions: Applicant must be a Matribhasha Satyagrahi of the Hindi Aandolan‑1957 and must have been imprisoned for participating in the movement.
Beneficiary must open an Aadhaar‑linked savings bank account in any nationalized bank to receive the pension.
Beneficiary must provide a live certificate every January.

If a Satyagrahi receives a pension or honorarium from another State Government, they remain eligible, but the Haryana pension will be reduced by the amount received if it is less than ₹10,000 per month.
In case of the death of a Satyagrahi, the monthly pension continues to be paid to the surviving spouse.
benefits_summary: A monthly pension of ₹10,000 is provided to eligible Matribhasha Satyagrahis (or their surviving spouse) by the Haryana government.
